PC: Provide volume resuscitation with IV buffered crystalloid fluid boluses.
Send appropriate initial labs (accucheck, CBC, CMP, lactate, blood gas, blood culture, coags, type and cross).
Draw blood cultures and initiate early and appropriate broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy.
Attempt bag-mask ventilation and intubation when indicated.
MK: Make a clinical diagnosis of shock.
Recognize clinical deterioration in a patient with septic shock.
